issue.title: test_batch_task_type_registry_reflects_each_project_cwd constructs InitPlan without its required 'actions' field
issue.description: Discovered as a pre-existing failure while running just check/just test-scoped for unrelated plan 202609/v2_adoption_unwedges_v1.md; not caused by that plan's diff.

task_type_fields.impact: The test's plan() callback returns InitPlan(command="memory", label="Memory", summary=""), but InitPlan now requires a positional 'actions' argument, so run_init_onboarding_all fails every project with 'InitPlan.__init__() missing 1 required positional argument: actions' and the test's exit_code==0 assertion fails (gets 1). The test fixture was not updated after InitPlan gained the required field. Fix: pass an actions value (e.g. an empty tuple/list, matching the current InitPlan contract) in the test's plan() callback.
